text: Clearly, first we must commit to doing no harm as strength training and conditioning professionals. Like all athletic activities, injury is a possibility and we must prepare such that we reduce the likelihood of injury. We will cover safety, injury prevention, and risk management in the final chapter to ensure you leave this manual with safety foremost in your mind. Fortunately, injuries in strength training and conditioning are rare but constant vigilance and good judgment are always required (6,7,8). Risk management is a tactic that is used to reduce the likelihood of injuries along with the likelihood of legal problems that often accompany injuries.
